new_quality_rule.rule: For material-event candidates, recent-event readiness requires an authoritative primary event/disclosure timestamp inside the accepted event window. A recent secondary article that references an older primary event cannot satisfy event recency by itself.
new_quality_rule.effect: Both current material-event candidates remain recent_event_ready=false.
